from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxesData(BaseModel):
    """Tax payable data from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/trading code if provided")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    taxes_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The '应交税费' ending balance amount")
    taxes_payable_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., '元')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="The verbatim or near-verbatim line containing the tax amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """All company tax payable data extracted from the collection of documents."""
    companies_taxes_data: list[CompanyTaxesData]
